description.zh: 应用ID，通过控制台创建和查询，仅支持传单个ID。
description.en: The application ID, which is created and queried in the console. Only a single ID is supported.

description.zh: 已入会的频道ID，仅支持传单个ID。
description.en: The ID of the channel that has been joined. Only a single ID is supported.

descriptions.zh:
# 使用说明
本接口用于删除频道。
# QPS限制
本接口无单用户QPS限制，请您根据实际需要合理调用。更多信息，请参见[QPS限制](~~341645~~)。
descriptions.en:
# Usage notes
This operation is used to delete a channel.
# QPS limits
No single-user QPS limit is imposed on this operation. Call this operation in a reasonable manner based on your actual needs. For more information, see [QPS limits](~~341645~~).
